records.title: h_1_hook.png
records.hook: my grandmother has spoken gheg her whole life. these are the 5 phrases she says that google translate gets completely wrong
records.caption: she's 78 and she'll never switch to english for me. sayla actually speaks gheg, not textbook albanian. link in bio

records.title: h_2_phrase.png
records.hook: 1. "A po vjen me na pa?" — she's not asking IF you're coming. she's telling you people are waiting
records.caption: she's 78 and she'll never switch to english for me. sayla actually speaks gheg, not textbook albanian. link in bio

records.title: h_3_phrase.png
records.hook: 2. "Une jam plake, mos prit shume" — translate says "I am old, don't wait long." she means: come while I can still cook for you
records.caption: she's 78 and she'll never switch to english for me. sayla actually speaks gheg, not textbook albanian. link in bio

records.title: h_4_phrase.png
records.hook: 3. "Sa mall qe kam per ty bir" — "how much mall do I have for you." mall has no english. it's missing someone with your hands
records.caption: she's 78 and she'll never switch to english for me. sayla actually speaks gheg, not textbook albanian. link in bio

records.title: h_5_phrase.png
records.hook: 4. "qysh je bre" — literally "how are you bre." but bre is a hug inside a word. nobody teaches you bre
records.caption: she's 78 and she'll never switch to english for me. sayla actually speaks gheg, not textbook albanian. link in bio

records.title: h_6_phrase.png
records.hook: 5. "Fol shqip sonte, te lutem" — "speak albanian tonight, I beg you." that one's for you. she means it
records.caption: she's 78 and she'll never switch to english for me. sayla actually speaks gheg, not textbook albanian. link in bio
